Adding a NIC to a bridge (and removing i: Adding a NIC to a bridge (and removing it later) makes NetworkManager re-activate it on every node. Everything on top of it goes down and is rebuilt: its VLAN interfaces, the cluster network if br-ex uses it, and the macvlan/ipvlan interfaces of pods, which do not come back until those pods restart. With ODF on Multus this takes Ceph down.
Bridge the whole NIC anyway. I understan: Bridge the whole NIC anyway. I understand the networks listed above go down on each node while it is applied, and the affected pods must be restarted afterwards.
I understand. Remove it one node at a ti: I understand. Remove it one node at a time and offer to restart the affected pods afterwards.
